# `smelt`

<!-- Auto-generated by `cargo xtask gen-lua-docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Tier:** `UiHost` — Requires a terminal UI; calling these from headless mode raises.

Root smelt namespace. Host-tier bindings are registered first; UiHost-tier bindings are injected when a TUI is active.

## `smelt.quit`

```lua
fun(): nil
```

Request a clean shutdown of the app. The quit fires on the next tick after the current handler returns.

## `smelt.spawn`

```lua
fun(handler: fun()): nil
```

Run `handler` as a fire-and-forget coroutine on the Lua task runtime. The handler may yield; its result is discarded.
